title: Wager Predict (BSC) — LMSR prediction market + LP Vault + USDW wrapper

All 21 markets are Listed/open (endDates 2027-02..2028-11) -> no settlement exists to attack
ResolutionModule.propose requires RESOLVER/GOVERNANCE because config.permissionlessResolution()=false -> no stranger resolution
